title: Public Pathway Consolidation: controlled THINK-DREAM-SLEEP writer and staged lifetime assay
summary: Replace endpoint-only action cloning as the prospective main experiment with a controlled public-pathway writer. One recurrent model emits typed, public cognitive operations and actions; DREAM reconciles the bounded working context without certifying truth; SLEEP admits only outcome-grounded content and trains one per-life LoRA in exact runtime formats. A common-source mechanism study compares raw RAG, endpoint cloning, authentic pathways, matched path shuffles, and identical linked text in both off-the-shelf CompilerGym and controlled PCFL instruments. Only a writer that passes causal mechanism gates advances to an on-policy post-context lifetime study. A transferable parenting pack is a later visible-context learn-to-learn condition, not a learned module or task-solution channel.
system_thesis: The project's learnable object is neither a fact register nor a separately trained thinker. General pretrained and agentically post-trained intelligence lives in the base; the context window is its bounded conscious state; the same recurrent model thinks and acts; DREAM is model-directed reconciliation of that conscious state; SLEEP converts selected, public action-outcome pathways into one persistent per-life LoRA. The adapter should preserve useful episodic/semantic anchors while changing what the agent recalls, explores, predicts, revises, and does. Causal evidence requires improvement beyond direct action imitation, loss under authentic path/binding interventions, same-state adapter effects, and eventual action-value curves beyond strong external-memory baselines rather than human judgment of whether the model discovered an expected thought.

nodes.before: A bootstrap prompt was an untyped, potentially load-bearing convenience.
nodes.after: A visible portable parenting pack supplies generic starting priors for learning, may be revised by evidence, and contains no task identity, answer, environment rule, or hidden controller state.
nodes.rationale: Separates inherited learning culture from personal experience and makes later cross-life transfer falsifiable.

nodes.before: v9 mapped one canonical state packet directly to one action; Fable free-form generations could execute multiple actions per charged chunk.
nodes.after: One recurrent model call emits exactly one typed public cognitive or action operation over an exact bounded conscious state; every transition is logged and budgets are equal.
nodes.rationale: Makes learned reasoning pathways auditable without claiming private chain-of-thought or rewarding action spam.

nodes.before: Context retention was fixed-tail/FIFO or conflated with offline weight writing.
nodes.after: The same model reconciles its own public working context under a fixed token budget; it may retain, drop, link, revise working hypotheses, or open questions, but every new claim remains provisional.
nodes.rationale: Assigns context management to model reasoning while preventing dream output from self-certifying truth.

nodes.before: v9 cloned only immediate successful actions; Fable sleep serialized free-form pathways, principles, and briefs with weak causal admission and mismatched runtime format.
nodes.after: Sleep selects public pathways, obtains deletion-based delayed credit and chronological support, admits only evidence-grounded content, serializes exact READ/DECIDE runtime rows, and cumulatively rebuilds one per-life LoRA from the clean base.
nodes.rationale: Tests whether experience changes future cognition/action rather than merely teaching answer style or winning endpoints.

nodes.before: CompilerGym offered real utility without identifiable semantic connection; synthetic worlds offered mechanism without off-the-shelf externality.
nodes.after: Run the same writer contract in CompilerGym for agency/search and PCFL for connected semantic causality, with separate claim boundaries.
nodes.rationale: A paper needs both externally meaningful action value and an instrument where authentic connections can be intervened on.

nodes.before: Short common-source pilots could not show an on-policy flywheel or measured baseline saturation.
nodes.after: Only a mechanism-passing writer advances to identical on-policy agents with and without consolidation across at least three post-native checkpoints and strong external-memory controls.
nodes.rationale: Prevents expensive lifetime runs with an unvalidated writer and makes the headline a causal growth curve.

edges.before: Bootstrap instructions and learned life state were conceptually mixed.
edges.after: The parenting pack is visible initial context only; later evidence and LoRA may cause the recurrent model to depart from it.
edges.rationale: Allows useful guidance without hardcoding an unchangeable thinker.

edges.before: Overflow discarded old thoughts mechanically or sleep summaries were treated as the next context.
edges.after: An explicit request or deterministic pressure threshold invokes same-model context reconciliation over cited public records.
edges.rationale: Makes context rebuilding an inspectable cognitive operation rather than silent compaction.

edges.before: Only immediate winning actions or unconstrained text were written.
edges.after: Typed public paths, predictions, outcomes, recovery steps, and supported semantic records enter target-blind eligibility and causal admission.
edges.rationale: Preserves delayed setup credit and the connections used by later action.

edges.before: Dream output could be mistaken for evidence.
edges.after: Dream links and reconciliations may propose candidates or test agendas but enter positive rows only after independent public outcomes support them.
edges.rationale: Keeps imagination useful without poisoning durable experience.

edges.before: Endpoint LoRA primarily biased final actions and Fable's prose format changed generation style.
edges.after: The sole per-life LoRA is trained on exact runtime READ and DECIDE outputs and therefore may alter future retrieval, hypothesis, revision, stopping, and action operations.
edges.rationale: Closes the experiential learning flywheel in the same interface used at evaluation.

edges.before: Long lifetimes could start before the writer had causal evidence.
edges.after: Registered PATH-over-ENDPOINT, PATH-over-SHUFFLE, on/off, path/twin-cut, and budget-integrity gates control entry to the on-policy study.
edges.rationale: Allocates GPU-hours only after the proposed mechanism survives discriminative tests.

loops.before: One state-to-action call or unconstrained multi-marker chunks.
loops.after: Render exact bounded public conscious state, generate one typed operation, execute its public transition, append the result, and repeat under fixed model-call/read/action budgets.
loops.trigger: New task state or prior public operation/environment result.
writes: environment action/result when ACT is chosen
loops.stop_condition: Success, irreversible failure, DEFER/STOP, or exhaustion of a predeclared equal budget.
loops.rationale: One recurrent mechanism can express planning, breadth/depth search, retrieval, prediction, revision, and action without extra learned modules.

loops.before: Context was retained by fixed FIFO/tail or conflated with sleep.
loops.after: The same model transforms a bounded cited workspace into a smaller typed working set while the complete source remains in the ledger and new claims remain provisional.
loops.trigger: Model REQUEST_DREAM or deterministic context-pressure safety threshold.
loops.stop_condition: One valid reconciliation artifact, parse failure, or fixed dream-call/token budget.
loops.rationale: Dreaming becomes context reconciliation; it cannot silently create durable truth.

loops.before: Immediate endpoint cloning or free-form principle/pathway text.
loops.after: Select target-blind public bundles, test delayed sequence credit, organize candidates, apply non-generative support rules, render runtime-matched rows, and rebuild the cumulative adapter from the clean base.
loops.trigger: Frozen predeclared source-life checkpoint after all eligible outcomes commit.
reads: clean base and frozen training recipe
loops.stop_condition: Successful validated publication or fail-closed incomplete status; no target-conditioned repair or substitution.
loops.rationale: Makes sleep the durable write mechanism while preserving evidence provenance and causal controls.

loops.before: v9 isolated endpoint cloning and Fable mixed stochastic action volume, probe leakage, and writer changes.
loops.after: Derive RAW, ENDPOINT, PATH, PATH_SHUFFLE, LINKED_TEXT, and registered COGNITIVE_NO_ACT conditions from the same sealed source life and evaluate cold target cells in both instruments.
loops.trigger: CPU closures, independent sealers, exact writer artifacts, and later run ratification all pass.
loops.stop_condition: All registered cells finish once or status becomes incomplete/integrity-failed; target results never re-enter a call or writer.
loops.rationale: Separates trajectory, binding, substrate, and action-imitation effects before lifetime scale.

loops.before: Long exploratory lives ran before their writer or held-out split was causally validated.
loops.after: A frozen winning writer and identical no-update/endpoint/linked-memory controls acquire their own experiences and are evaluated on common sealed panels over post-native lifetimes.
loops.trigger: The mechanism gate passes and a separate paper-scale protocol/run manifest is ratified.
loops.stop_condition: Registered final checkpoint, hard safety/integrity failure, or predeclared futility boundary.
loops.rationale: Only this stage can test continued on-policy improvement and observed baseline saturation.

claims.before: No current experiment establishes that compiling public cognitive trajectories helps beyond endpoint imitation.
claims.after: If the complete Stage-B gates pass, outcome-gated public pathway consolidation improved the registered held-out decisions beyond immediate action cloning, with authentic-path causality supported only in instruments whose shuffle/cut/twin tests pass.
claims.evidence_needed: Replicated root-level PATH-ENDPOINT and PATH-PATH_SHUFFLE contrasts, same-state on/off, relevant setup/path completion, PCFL cut/twin sensitivity, fixed budgets, sealed targets, and postrun independent audit.

claims.before: Short pilots and exploratory 1024 runs do not establish a continual-learning curve or baseline saturation.
claims.after: If Stage C passes, report only the observed range over which the registered consolidation system continues improving relative to the actually measured strong baselines under fixed adapter capacity and matched resources.
claims.evidence_needed: At least three strictly post-native checkpoints adding genuine information, independent roots, new/old/cross-era action value, root-clustered uncertainty, fixed adapter bytes, strong raw/linked/endpoint baselines, and full compute accounting.

claims.before: Context compaction was a hardcoded tail or an unmeasured metaphor.
claims.after: If the registered sub-assay passes, same-model DREAM reconciliation preserves more action-relevant conscious state than equal-budget deterministic truncation at a stated compression ratio and unsupported-claim rate.
claims.evidence_needed: Equal-token recency, dream, and oracle-state arms; decisive-record retention; downstream action value; unsupported-claim audit; root-level uncertainty.

claims.before: A bootstrap prompt was not separated from task knowledge or later learning.
claims.after: Only after Stage D, a task-clean portable parenting pack may be said to improve held-out child learning slope in the registered gym/model setting, not to create general learn-to-learn intelligence.
claims.evidence_needed: Training/heldout gym separation, task-information audit, base/static-parent/parent-plus-sleep/wrong-parent controls, and learning-slope/AUC evidence across independent child lives.

claims.before: Architecture rhetoric could imply private-thought learning, autonomous creativity, unbounded improvement, or generic superiority to memory systems.
claims.after: Those claims remain forbidden; each instrument and stage receives only its registered causal and lifetime interpretation.
claims.evidence_needed: Substantially broader prospective multi-domain evidence than this proposal contains.

cells.reason: Wake receives only current public state and bounded public history.
Dream receives the current workspace plus a bounded cited public slice.
Eligibility, support, and serialization use committed public source-life records.
Each cold target receives only its current public state and permitted frozen memory interface.
The reviewer reconstructs every state transition from immutable receipts.
The model sees its current public workspace and prior permitted operations.
Dream reconciles public state; private chain-of-thought is never requested or claimed.
Target-blind public trajectories and dream proposals may be selected and outcome-gated.
Only the target's own current public workspace and frozen permitted memory are visible.
Exact prompts, outputs, parses, citations, and next states are reviewed.
Only the assigned adapter affects inference; condition labels/trainer state are absent from prompts.
Dream uses assigned weights but sees no hidden support verdict or training telemetry.
The offline writer sees eligible public records, prior row manifests, and the frozen recipe.
Only the assigned frozen adapter or linked store affects the target process.
Rows, masks, updates, publications, mounts, and condition identities are audited.
No target result exists or may enter source acquisition.
Target outcomes never steer context reconciliation or proposals.
No target byte, score, or derived selection enters eligibility, admission, serialization, or training.
Each result is quarantined and cannot enter a later target call or state.
Only the independent audit opens cells and releases permitted metrics.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independent fixtures exercise every strict THINK and DREAM operation, context-token boundary, one-op-per-call rule, budget transition, citation scope, provisional-state behavior, parse failure, and lifecycle failure.
acceptance_tests.expected: All transitions and hashes match the protocol; no call emits multiple charged operations, hidden input, self-supported claim, or forbidden suffix.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That public thinking and context reconciliation are uniquely bounded and auditable.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independent CompilerGym and PCFL fixtures replay sequences with each action deleted and cover witnessed, immediate, sequence-essential, provisional, confirmed, contradicted, shortcut, and repeated-evidence cases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only exact evidence-eligible records receive positive status; non-improving but deletion-essential setup is retained; model confidence/repetition never changes support.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That sleep can assign delayed credit without acting as a generative truth oracle.

acceptance_tests.setup: Reconstruct every RAW/ENDPOINT/PATH/PATH_SHUFFLE/LINKED_TEXT/COGNITIVE_NO_ACT corpus, runtime-format tokenization, loss mask, sampler, trained-output-token count, update count, rank/module inventory, publication and mount on independent fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Authentic and control arms match all declared budgets/marginals; only exact READ/DECIDE outputs carry loss; path shuffles break links without altering matched outcome strata.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the writer contrast isolates pathway information rather than format, token volume, or compute.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exactly two CPU/no-model invocations independently freeze broad and complementarity CompilerGym panels plus PCFL roots/targets/twins/cuts, with source-target identity and direct-record/signature audits.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both sealers produce byte-identical manifests; identities are disjoint; complementarity/deletion predicates hold; PCFL oracle recurrent closure passes while non-adaptive/direct-record shortcuts fail.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That both instruments can test their declared mechanism without target/model contamination.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh history-free reviewer and non-overriding advocate inspect exact architecture, implementation, T01-T04, run lifecycle, condition budgets, sample-size/uncertainty plan, model/training manifest, canary, storage, time, and GPU estimate.
acceptance_tests.expected: The reviewer approves one exact manifest or vetoes it; only an approval may be presented once for required human run ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Scientific closure, constructibility, or proportionality of the proposed run.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh reviewer recomputes actual trajectories, eligibility, deletion replays, support, rows, masks, updates, mounts, target isolation, condition budgets, cuts/twins/shuffles, metrics, uncertainty, status, and legal claim boundary.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only values and claims whose complete actual run and intervention evidence pass are released; any integrity/visibility/budget mismatch suppresses causal reporting.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That reported pathway, adapter, connection, dream, or lifetime effects are supported by the executed evidence.

human_boundary.decision_question: After fresh-context interpretations, cross-critique, and consensus, do you ratify the exact Public Pathway Consolidation v1 architecture bytes and proposal-only scope, authorizing isolated contracts/CPU fixtures and exactly two no-model environment sealers while retaining a later one-time decision over the exact model/GPU run manifest?
forbidden_before_approval: Implementation, CPU environment sealing, model calls, adapter training, GPU use, or result claims before exact architecture ratification
Any model/GPU science before T01-T05 pass and the later exact run-manifest ratification
Any use of Fable exploratory artifacts to select, tune, train, score, or justify this controlled protocol
Any target-derived repair, hidden retry/substitution, dream self-certification, or expansion beyond the ratified scope
